decisive_items: a ~9 mm round, hyperechoic mass adherent to the ventricular surface of the anterior tricuspid leaflet
a 6×8 mm non-solid structure on the ventricular aspect of the anterior tricuspid leaflet with a “finger-in-glove” blind-ended protrusion
internally empty with filamentous adherent elements (“garland-like”)
response.rationale: The description of a hyperechoic mass with a 'finger-in-glove' protrusion and 'garland-like' elements is consistent with Papillary Fibroelastoma

rejected.why: Lack of direct evidence for Lambert-Eaton Myasthenic Syndrome in the vignette
Atherosclerotic disease is not directly related to the mass on the tricuspid leaflet
Negative blood cultures and lack of other evidence for Endocarditis
